author: Julia Fedorin
text:
She left Waterloo without graduating. Now she's a Member of Technical Staff at @OpenAI.

@BrookeaJoseph joined a 12-person startup called @skybysoftware as an intern. Six months later, OpenAI acquired it. Now she does agent post-training research on computer use full-time, teaching models to click, type, and operate any software a human can.

I sat down with her in Washington Square Park to get into:

•Why she takes jobs she's "unqualified" for and how you build that confidence •What makes software feel magical •Why computer use is the road to AGI •When you should not let an agent use your computer •How she learns and why she still does it by hand
